beats.at: write it out for him on the typewriter
beats.name: BK2V-05a · Mina at the typewriter
beats.words: …write it out for him on the typewriter, at which also I am practising very hard.
beats.note: Replaces the three typing pictures (the typist reads as a boy).

beats.name: BK2V-21a · Number Two, the Texan
beats.words: He is such a nice fellow, an American from Texas, and he looks so young and so fresh…
beats.note: Quincey with his face reference, to replace the drifting faces.

beats.name: BK2V-27a · Quincey’s farewell
beats.words: Little girl, I hold your hand, and you’ve kissed me… (the kiss of friendship)
beats.note: Quincey as in 21a; replaces the two kiss pictures with a different man.
beats.prompt: BK2V-27a oil painting, 1890s, romantic Victorian painting, golden afternoon light by a tall window, a tall young American with a light moustache holding both hands of a fair-haired girl in white, she rises on tiptoe to kiss his cheek in friendship, tears in her eyes, his face brave and kind --ar 16:9 --sref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ch05-lucyday-window-1.jpg --oref https://ianingram.github.io/Amenti-Readings/dracula/art/ref/bk2-quincey.jpg --no abstract, modern, kissing on the lips
